data.name: WithoutEyes Chapter1
data.detailed_description:
For those of you in a hurry who want to get to know us quickly:

Game Overview

Psycho-Horror ADV, Story-Focused

Playtime: 3+ hours

Platform: Windows only (for now)

Please read the warnings carefully before playing.

Game Features

  • Map Exploration

  • Choice-Based Multiple Endings

  • Letter Rearrangement Puzzles

  • Mentally Disorder, Cannibalism and the bended pure...first love.

    "No matter how much I want to die, you're scared of death."
    "It’s not that I loved this hell because you were there. In this hell, there was nothing I could love but you."
    "In the end, everyone thinks they’re the most pitiable person in the world."
    "Even if I forget you, I have loved you. Always, and forever…"

Character Introductions

  •    Amy – A girl who will die if she doesn’t drink blood     

       Alfred – A boy who will die if he doesn’t eat human meat

  • Sarya – A strange boy who says he is a doctor

    “Peculiar Psychiatric Anomalies”

    These are not ordinary mental illnesses. In this world, patients with extreme, unusual symptoms are called this.

    Each of them carries trauma, yet they are admitted to the ward and try to live “normally.”

    The stage is set in St. Louis, USA, in the late 2000s.

    Two patients were observed… and their location was a brothel.

    "We’re the same age, so we can get along… It’s not like we’ve decided to enter yet, Dr.Maia."

    By the time Sariya arrived, it was already too late.

    Because the two had already ruined everything but each other … no, I guess from long ago… .

    "As long as that dude related the ward, I will never go to that ward."

    A boy-meats-girl story of cannibalism and co-dependency between a young man and woman.

"…Still, cruelly, tomorrow will come. No one wants to live. But we have no choice but to live. Right?"

===Captions and warnings===

All characters are 20 years or older.

We welcome comments, bug reports, and impressions.

The characters are fictional and have no relation to any real person or organization.

We strongly recommend that people who are mentally or physically unstable refrain from playing.

Play at your own risk. If you feel uncomfortable while playing, please stop immediately.

We do not take any responsibility for any trauma caused by this game.

Some aspects are inspired by real mental disorders, but we have no intention of insulting anyone.

———— Staff Notes ————

Withoueyes Fan Work Guidelines

Disrespectful acts toward real-world patients or people with disabilities are strictly prohibited.

Please respect each other.

We also ask that the sexual orientation and minority status of each character be respected. Since this is fan content, feel free to explore freely within these boundaries.

If you notice posts violating the above guidelines, the staff may contact you and request removal.

Stream and playthrough Guidelines

You can post Let's Play or streaming videos of Furutsuki’s games without reporting to us.

Adding tags is appreciated, so your videos can be found more easily.

In case of any issues, staff may contact you.

ーーーーThe staff of WithoutEyes Ward wishes to make your stay here as comfortable as possible.ーーー

Thank you for reading this far. We’d be happy if you download and experience our game.

data.short_description: Don't look away, Stare at their formation of attachment. A psychological horror ADV depicting the twisted pure love between a girl who dies without drinking blood and a boy who dies without eating human meat.
